summary.text: Musha-e (武者絵), a type of Japanese art developed in the late 18th century, is a genre of the ukiyo-e woodblock printing technique. It represents images of warriors and samurai from Japanese history and mythology.

As the ukiyo-e technique thrived during the 19th century, musha-e became more popular. Kuniyoshi, a famous printmaker, specialized in warrior images and produced a series of prints known as the 108 Heroes of the Suikoden.
